newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE extends Moldova, Tajikistan missions.
newsitem.headline: OSCE extends Moldova, Tajikistan missions.

text.p: The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said on Thursday it was extending its mandate for missions in Moldova and Tajikistan by six months.
Both long-term missions in the former Soviet states would remain until June 30, 1997, an OSCE spokesman told Reuters.
The 53-member body has 10 long-term missions to supervise human and minority rights in crisis areas.
The Vienna-based OSCE permanent council is currently holding its annual month-long policy review.
